explanation: Fires on the opening piece of a word that the tokenizer splits into several subword tokens, when that piece is an unfinished stem that only makes sense with a suffix still to come (e.g. ' compl'|acent, ' termin'|us, ' h'|ailing, ' penetr'|ance, ' dys'|lexia, free-s|'pir'|ited, cere|'bell'|ar, fo|'resh'|adow, honderdvij|'ft'|ig). It is weak (under about 0.3 of max) on whole words and on the suffix piece, so the same meaning written as one token, or a word swapped for a one-token synonym, loses most of the activation. A weaker secondary firing (about 0.3-0.9 of max) falls on a position just before a digit in a count or percentage, such as ' (' in '23 (58%)', or '8/' in '8/10'.
